scene.label: Act 4, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. Florence. A room in the Widow's house.
scene.location: Florence. A room in the Widow's house.

lines.text: They told me that your name was Fontybell.
lines.plainText: They told me that your name was Fontybell

lines.text: No, my good lord, Diana.
lines.plainText: No my good lord Diana

lines.text: Titled goddess;
lines.plainText: Titled goddess

lines.text: And worth it, with addition! But, fair soul,
lines.plainText: And worth it with addition But fair soul

lines.text: In your fine frame hath love no quality?
lines.plainText: In your fine frame hath love no quality

lines.text: If the quick fire of youth light not your mind,
lines.plainText: If the quick fire of youth light not your mind

lines.text: You are no maiden but a monument;
lines.plainText: You are no maiden but a monument

lines.text: When you are dead, you should be such a one
lines.plainText: When you are dead you should be such a one

lines.text: As you are now; for you are cold and stern,
lines.plainText: As you are now for you are cold and stern

lines.text: And now you should be as your mother was
lines.plainText: And now you should be as your mother was

lines.text: When your sweet self was got.
lines.plainText: When your sweet self was got

lines.text: She then was honest.
lines.plainText: She then was honest

lines.text: So should you be.
lines.plainText: So should you be

lines.text: No.
lines.plainText: No

lines.text: My mother did but duty; such, my lord,
lines.plainText: My mother did but duty such my lord

lines.text: As you owe to your wife.
lines.plainText: As you owe to your wife

lines.text: No more a' that!
lines.plainText: No more a' that

lines.text: I pr'ythee do not strive against my vows;
lines.plainText: I pr'ythee do not strive against my vows

lines.text: I was compell'd to her; but I love thee
lines.plainText: I was compell'd to her but I love thee

lines.text: By love's own sweet constraint, and will for ever
lines.plainText: By love's own sweet constraint and will for ever

lines.text: Do thee all rights of service.
lines.plainText: Do thee all rights of service

lines.text: Ay, so you serve us
lines.plainText: Ay so you serve us

lines.text: Till we serve you; but when you have our roses,
lines.plainText: Till we serve you but when you have our roses

lines.text: You barely leave our thorns to prick ourselves,
lines.plainText: You barely leave our thorns to prick ourselves

lines.text: And mock us with our bareness.
lines.plainText: And mock us with our bareness

lines.text: How have I sworn?
lines.plainText: How have I sworn

lines.text: 'Tis not the many oaths that makes the truth,
lines.plainText: 'Tis not the many oaths that makes the truth

lines.text: But the plain single vow that is vow'd true.
lines.plainText: But the plain single vow that is vow'd true

lines.text: What is not holy, that we swear not by,
lines.plainText: What is not holy that we swear not by

lines.text: But take the highest to witness: then, pray you, tell me,
lines.plainText: But take the highest to witness then pray you tell me

lines.text: If I should swear by Jove's great attributes
lines.plainText: If I should swear by Jove's great attributes

lines.text: I lov'd you dearly, would you believe my oaths
lines.plainText: I lov'd you dearly would you believe my oaths

lines.text: When I did love you ill? This has no holding,
lines.plainText: When I did love you ill This has no holding

lines.text: To swear by him whom I protest to love
lines.plainText: To swear by him whom I protest to love

lines.text: That I will work against him. Therefore your oaths
lines.plainText: That I will work against him Therefore your oaths

lines.text: Are words and poor conditions; but unseal'd,—
lines.plainText: Are words and poor conditions but unseal'd

lines.text: At least in my opinion.
lines.plainText: At least in my opinion

lines.text: Change it, change it.
lines.plainText: Change it change it

lines.text: Be not so holy-cruel. Love is holy;
lines.plainText: Be not so holycruel Love is holy

lines.text: And my integrity ne'er knew the crafts
lines.plainText: And my integrity ne'er knew the crafts

lines.text: That you do charge men with. Stand no more off,
lines.plainText: That you do charge men with Stand no more off

lines.text: But give thyself unto my sick desires,
lines.plainText: But give thyself unto my sick desires

lines.text: Who then recovers. Say thou art mine, and ever
lines.plainText: Who then recovers Say thou art mine and ever

lines.text: My love as it begins shall so persever.
lines.plainText: My love as it begins shall so persever

lines.text: I see that men make hopes in such a case,
lines.plainText: I see that men make hopes in such a case

lines.text: That we'll forsake ourselves. Give me that ring.
lines.plainText: That we'll forsake ourselves Give me that ring

lines.text: I'll lend it thee, my dear, but have no power
lines.plainText: I'll lend it thee my dear but have no power

lines.text: To give it from me.
lines.plainText: To give it from me

lines.text: Will you not, my lord?
lines.plainText: Will you not my lord

lines.text: It is an honour 'longing to our house,
lines.plainText: It is an honour 'longing to our house

lines.text: Bequeathed down from many ancestors,
lines.plainText: Bequeathed down from many ancestors

lines.text: Which were the greatest obloquy i' the world
lines.plainText: Which were the greatest obloquy i' the world

lines.text: In me to lose.
lines.plainText: In me to lose

lines.text: Mine honour's such a ring;
lines.plainText: Mine honour's such a ring

lines.text: My chastity's the jewel of our house,
lines.plainText: My chastity's the jewel of our house

lines.text: Bequeathed down from many ancestors,
lines.plainText: Bequeathed down from many ancestors

lines.text: Which were the greatest obloquy i' the world
lines.plainText: Which were the greatest obloquy i' the world

lines.text: In me to lose. Thus your own proper wisdom
lines.plainText: In me to lose Thus your own proper wisdom

lines.text: Brings in the champion honour on my part
lines.plainText: Brings in the champion honour on my part

lines.text: Against your vain assault.
lines.plainText: Against your vain assault

lines.text: Here, take my ring;
lines.plainText: Here take my ring

lines.text: My house, mine honour, yea, my life be thine,
lines.plainText: My house mine honour yea my life be thine

lines.text: And I'll be bid by thee.
lines.plainText: And I'll be bid by thee

lines.text: When midnight comes, knock at my chamber window;
lines.plainText: When midnight comes knock at my chamber window

lines.text: I'll order take my mother shall not hear.
lines.plainText: I'll order take my mother shall not hear

lines.text: Now will I charge you in the band of truth,
lines.plainText: Now will I charge you in the band of truth

lines.text: When you have conquer'd my yet maiden-bed,
lines.plainText: When you have conquer'd my yet maidenbed

lines.text: Remain there but an hour, nor speak to me.
lines.plainText: Remain there but an hour nor speak to me

lines.text: My reasons are most strong; and you shall know them
lines.plainText: My reasons are most strong and you shall know them

lines.text: When back again this ring shall be deliver'd;
lines.plainText: When back again this ring shall be deliver'd

lines.text: And on your finger in the night, I'll put
lines.plainText: And on your finger in the night I'll put

lines.text: Another ring, that what in time proceeds
lines.plainText: Another ring that what in time proceeds

lines.text: May token to the future our past deeds.
lines.plainText: May token to the future our past deeds

lines.text: Adieu till then; then fail not. You have won
lines.plainText: Adieu till then then fail not You have won

lines.text: A wife of me, though there my hope be done.
lines.plainText: A wife of me though there my hope be done

lines.text: A heaven on earth I have won by wooing thee.
lines.plainText: A heaven on earth I have won by wooing thee

lines.text: For which live long to thank both heaven and me!
lines.plainText: For which live long to thank both heaven and me

lines.text: You may so in the end.
lines.plainText: You may so in the end

lines.text: My mother told me just how he would woo,
lines.plainText: My mother told me just how he would woo

lines.text: As if she sat in's heart. She says all men
lines.plainText: As if she sat in's heart She says all men

lines.text: Have the like oaths. He had sworn to marry me
lines.plainText: Have the like oaths He had sworn to marry me

lines.text: When his wife's dead; therefore I'll lie with him
lines.plainText: When his wife's dead therefore I'll lie with him

lines.text: When I am buried. Since Frenchmen are so braid,
lines.plainText: When I am buried Since Frenchmen are so braid

lines.text: Marry that will, I live and die a maid.
lines.plainText: Marry that will I live and die a maid

lines.text: Only, in this disguise, I think't no sin
lines.plainText: Only in this disguise I think't no sin

lines.text: To cozen him that would unjustly win.
lines.plainText: To cozen him that would unjustly win
